commit_scope: Close the gap the previous receipt left open: the zero-point ladder's lane tags were hand-typed beside a classifier already proven four-way. The ladder's twenty-two claims are now signal tuples in a Form band and eg-lane computes every lane, four-way at 65535. The page carries the computed output, which corrected the author in five places.
evidence_refs: WHY: Urs named that the work had been done WITH python and bash rather than THROUGH the body. The sharpest instance: the ladder carried hand-typed lane tags beside evidence-grounding.fk, a classifier already proven four-way. An epistemic ladder whose own lanes are asserted rather than run is precisely the failure the lane discipline exists to catch — an author grading their own claim. The previous receipt named this in its phase_gate and left it; this closes it.

COMPUTED, NOT TYPED: form-stdlib/tests/zero-point-ladder-band.fk holds the ladder's 22 claims as (name observed? independent? measured? derived? refuted?) tuples; eg-lane decides each lane. ./validate.sh form-stdlib/tests/zero-point-ladder-band.fk -> 'core.fk+evidence-grounding.fk+zero-point-ladder-band.fk -> 65535', 'fourth arm: 1 band(s) four-way (fkwu + pre-flattened tables)', '1 ok, 0 divergent'. Manifest row: zero-point-ladder fks 65535. Change a signal and the verdict moves, so the page and the engine cannot drift apart.

THE ENGINE CORRECTED THE AUTHOR, TWICE IN THE HARSH DIRECTION: the page had typed CONTESTED across the whole plasma-water end of the ladder. Only water-car computes to CONTESTED — the one claim with a real history of attempted and failed replication. water-shell-mechanism, brown-gas-tungsten, evo-vacuum-object and crater-transmutation all compute to INFERENCE: single-source and unreplicated, weaker than measured but NOT evidence against. Typing CONTESTED read a specific unverified mechanism as already-refuted, inside a document about not doing that.

IT ALSO SPLIT TWO FLATTENED RUNGS: Prigogine's conditions compute MEASURED while the orthogonal flux resting on them computes INFERENCE (Rung 8 had been tagged INFERENCE wholesale); plasmoids and Mesyats' ectons compute MEASURED while the EVO-as-vacuum-object reading computes INFERENCE (Rung 10 had been tagged 'MIXED'). Rung 14's suppression thesis computes MYSTERY and had carried no lane at all.

AN INVISIBLE FACT MADE VISIBLE BY COUNTING: practice = 0 across all twenty-two claims. The ladder holds no phenomenology whatsoever, which is what a physics ladder should look like and was not observable while the lanes were prose. Profile (measured theory practice inference contested mystery) = 7 7 0 6 1 1; surface = 14 grow tissue, 8 held below.

FOURTH-ARM CONSTRAINT ONE, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED — PRELUDE DEPTH: the fourth arm resolves a three-file chain (core + module + band). At four files the earliest module is dropped. With core+evidence-grounding+zero-point-ladder+band, fkwu returned the claim table INTACT (len 22, 6 fields, nth values correct) while every eg-lane call returned 0, including on a claim built inline in the band file. An isolation band pinned this: bits for len/nth passed, bits for eg-lane failed, giving fourth=22 against 31 on the walkers. A three-file band calling eg-lane on inline claims returns 5/4/1 correctly, four-way. So the claim table lives in the band, one module deep.

FOURTH-ARM CONSTRAINT TWO — NO LIST CONSTRUCTION: fourth-shim.fk carries no cons and no empty (grepped: shim=0, core=0 as defns), so any walk that CONSTRUCTS a list returns nothing on the fourth arm while the three walkers return it. Vocabulary is held to exactly what evidence-grounding.fk uses and proves — add / eq / ge / head / if / len / list / nth / tail — and nothing builds a list except a list literal, the shape eg-surface already proves. Both constraints were built around over the minimal proven core rather than patched in a walker, per the capability rule.

A FALSE LEAD RECORDED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: the first hypothesis was that core's higher-order `map` failed on fkwu. A probe returning a LIST could not test it, because the fourth arm's verdict channel is numeric — the walkers returned [22, 22, 5, 5] while fkwu returned the scalar 849. Replacing map with explicit cons-recursion did not move the band off 8192 either. Only the numeric isolation band located the real cause. The lesson kept: a probe whose return type the channel cannot carry proves nothing.
